python.limits: Yappi CPU clock, all Python threads including driver, server and probes. Self CPU is additive; cumulative/caller times overlap. Profiling overhead is not production cost.

native_trace.limits: Renderer main-thread trace tts/tdur only. Coverage union avoids nesting double-counts; smallest recorded enclosing interval is not a complete native stack. Unrecorded CPU and other threads remain unclassified.

js.limits: Trace-based V8 sample counts across contexts, not per-function CPU time. Signed deltas reconstruct sample timestamps; no negative elapsed weights assigned.
